pension.title: Pension leave account & lamp grant
pension.description: Calculate government pension leave balances and lamp grant from service and enjoyed leave.
pension.instructionsIntro: While calculating pension, government employees must work out two things:
pension.leaveAccount1: Complete service period and leave earned during service.
pension.leaveAccount2: Leave is of four account types: on average salary, on half-average salary, without pay, and regular working period, with sub-types under each.
pension.leaveAccount3: Add all enjoyed leave in one list. For each row choose days or from–to dates (days are calculated automatically from the date range). The summary groups totals by leave account type.
pension.leaveAccount4: Maternity leave: enter start date only. Before 18 May 2021 → 120 days; on/after 18 May 2021 → 180 days.
pension.leaveAccount5: REST leave is auto-deducted on the average-salary account (15 days every 3 years) unless you add a REST row to override.
pension.lampGrant1: If total average-salary leave is 18 months or more: last basic salary + 5% × 18 months.
pension.lampGrant2: If less than 18 months: last basic salary × remaining months (no 5% increase).
pension.rulesEmpty: Enter service dates and enjoyed leave to see which calculation rules apply at each stage.
pension.enjoyedLeaveHint: One list for all leave types. Enter days directly, or choose dates and days are calculated automatically. Summary below groups by leave account type.
pension.noTypes: No leave types configured. Contact an administrator.
pension.noRows: Add rows for leave enjoyed during service. For each row you can enter days or a from–to date range. REST is auto-deducted on the average-salary account if not listed.

deductionRule.leave_earning_only: Deduct from leave-earning period only (counts as working)
deductionRule.both: Deduct from leave-earning and working period

pension.stageService1: Join date is included; service days = inclusive days from join to end ({days} days).
pension.stageInputDays: Days input used for {count} enjoyed-leave row(s).
pension.stageInputDates: From–to dates used for {count} row(s); days = inclusive calendar days.
pension.stageInputRestAuto: REST (R&R) auto-applied: {cycles} complete 3-year cycle(s) × 15 days = {days} days on average-salary account.
pension.stageInputRestManual: REST (R&R) taken from enjoyed-leave list: {days} days (manual override of auto entitlement).
pension.stageInputRestNone: REST (R&R): no complete 3-year cycle yet — 0 days auto-applied.
pension.stageEarning6: Half-average → average pay = half balance ÷ 2 (round .5+ up).
pension.stageEarning7: Total leave balance = average balance + converted half-average → {balance} ({months} months).
pension.stageEarningPending1: Average-salary leave earned = leave-earning period ÷ 11 (round .5+ up).
pension.stageEarningPending2: Half-average leave earned = leave-earning period ÷ 12 (round .5+ up).
pension.stageEarningPending3: Balance = earning − enjoyed days for each account.
pension.stageEarningPending4: Total leave = average balance + (half-average balance ÷ 2, round .5+ up).
pension.stageLampNoBonus2: Lamp grant = last basic × {months} months (no 5% increase).
pension.stageLampPending1: If total average leave ≥ 18 months: (last basic + 5%) × 18.
pension.stageLampPending2: If less than 18 months: last basic × remaining months (no 5%).
pension.gratuityDescription: Monthly net pension and one-time gratuity from the mandatory 50% pension surrender, based on qualifying service years and last basic salary.
pension.gratuityAgeHint: Used only for the medical allowance rate (65 or older gets a higher rate). Leave blank to assume under 65.
pension.gratuityNotEligible: Not eligible: minimum 5 years of qualifying service required for pension or gratuity. Qualifying service so far: {years} year(s).
pension.gratuityLeaveEncashmentCap: PRL leave encashment (max, {months} months of last basic)
pension.exclusionsHint: Leave without pay, suspension, and unauthorized absence are picked up automatically from the Enjoyed Leave list above (add a row with that type) — no need to re-enter them here.
pension.dobHint: Used to auto-calculate boy service (service before age 18), which doesn't count toward pensionable service.
pension.boyServiceAuto: Boy service auto-calculated: {days} day(s) excluded (service before age 18)
pension.suspensionRegularizedLabel: Regularized as duty by order (don't exclude)
pension.qualifyingServiceExcludedNote: {days} day(s) excluded (boy service, PRL, without pay, suspension, contractual, unauthorized absence)

joining.title: Joining period calculator
joining.description: Calculate joining time (যোগদানকাল) for transfer or posting under Bangladesh service rules.
joining.sameStationIntro: Same station (no change of residence): only 1 day of joining period (leave is counted in that day).
joining.changeResidenceIntro: Change of residence: preparation {prep} days (weekly holidays excluded from the {prep}; government/optional holidays count) + travel days.
joining.fractionRule: Any fraction of a travel day counts as a full day
joining.approachRule: Approach ≤ {km} km (5 miles) to/from station or ghat is not counted
joining.airRule: Air: {prep} days preparation + actual journey time
joining.steamerRule: Steamer delay for unavoidable reasons counts as preparation
joining.multiJourneyRule: Multiple similar journeys are added together
joining.maxRule: Maximum {max} days including weekly holidays; HoD may extend for unavoidable delay within that cap
joining.handoverRule: If handover time is not mentioned as morning/afternoon, morning is assumed
joining.currentPractice: Current practice: travel is usually taken from actual journey time instead of the legacy distance formula.
joining.govHolidays: Government / optional holidays (YYYY-MM-DD, comma or new line)
joining.govHolidaysHint: These dates count within the joining period (unlike weekly holidays).
joining.weeklyNote: Additional — not counted in joining credit
joining.ruleSameStation: No change of residence (same station): only 1 day of joining period; leave is also counted in this 1 day.
joining.ruleChangeResidence: Change of residence (station to station): preparation + travel (+ delays/extensions), subject to a 30-day maximum including weekly holidays.
joining.rulePrep: Preparation: {prep} days. Weekly holidays within preparation are excluded from the {prep}-day count; government/optional holidays count within it.
joining.ruleWeekly: Weekly holidays are not included in joining-period credit (they are additional on the calendar). Declared government holidays count within the joining period.
joining.ruleMax: Maximum: joining period including weekly holidays must not exceed {max} days.
joining.ruleActual: Current practice: travel portion uses actual journey time instead of the legacy distance formula.
joining.ruleDistance: Legacy distance method: rail 250 mi/400 km, sea 200 mi/320 km, river 80 mi/128 km, bus 80 mi/128 km, road 15 mi/15 km per day; any fraction = full day.
joining.ruleApproach: Approach by road of {km} km (5 miles) or less to/from station/ghat is not counted.
joining.ruleHod: Head of Department extension: {days} day(s) for unavoidable delay (still subject to the {max}-day cap).
joining.ruleMulti: Multiple journeys: joining periods for similar journeys are added together.
joining.ruleHandoverAfternoon: Handover in the afternoon — joining period starts the next day.
joining.ruleHandoverMorning: Handover in the morning — joining period starts that day.
joining.ruleHandoverAssume: Handover time not mentioned — assumed morning; joining period starts that day.
joining.ruleHandoverNoDate: No handover date — calendar span estimated without weekly-holiday placement.
joining.ruleCapped: Result capped: calendar span including weekly holidays cannot exceed {max} days.
joining.ruleCappedNoDate: Capped at {max} days (including weekly holidays). Provide a handover date for a precise calendar span.
